title: Exit Through the Gift Shop
notes: Tower victory after the collapsed Surfer is dragged through St Brendan's nave and out the ceremonial west doors.

lines.text: You take the Surfer under the arms. Cloth gathers in your hands; his heels find the floor. The west doors are down the nave you walked to reach him.
Behind you, halfway down the nave, VISITOR SHOP still points south toward the route you did not take.
The Surfer makes a sound that may be a laugh. His weight remains human and inconvenient.
I cut you off them. Different job.
The dawn in the west glass is colour before it is warmth. The same cold chord remains in six panes, but nothing above them answers.
The west door takes your shoulder. You keep hold of him as one leaf opens. The closer brings it together behind you; from the yard there is no handle.
Exit through the gift shop. Fine. Stay awake.
Two bodies clear the threshold. Outside, his weight is only body weight and the bells are only metal cooling above an empty nave.
You heard the chair. Before the bells.
